subject: Cloud Computing
title: Virtual Networking in IaaS
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Virtual Networking in IaaS.

hook.text: Your cloud servers need a network. In IaaS, you design the entire network yourself — in software.

buildup.text: A VPC — Virtual Private Cloud — is your isolated network. You define subnets, routes, and gateways.

discovery.text: Security groups act as firewalls, controlling which traffic can enter or leave each server.

twist.text: A single misconfigured security group can expose your entire database to the public internet.

climax.text: Cloud networking is powerful but unforgiving. One wrong rule and your data is wide open.

punchline.text: Virtual networks are flexible. Misconfigured ones are dangerous.

quiz.question: What is a VPC (Virtual Private Cloud)?
options: An isolated virtual network you design and control in the cloud
A private cloud that only one person can access
A VPN connection between your office and the internet

details.summary: Virtual networking in IaaS lets you create isolated networks with custom IP ranges, subnets, route tables, and gateways entirely through software. VPCs provide the same network segmentation as physical data centers without any hardware.
details.whyItMatters: Network isolation is fundamental to cloud security. Virtual networking lets you architect secure, segmented environments that mirror enterprise data center topologies.
takeaways: VPCs create isolated virtual networks in the cloud
Subnets, routes, and gateways are all software-defined
Network segmentation is a core security control

faq.question: What is a VPC in practice?
faq.answer: A Virtual Private Cloud is a logically isolated section of the cloud where you define your own IP address ranges, subnets, route tables, and network gateways. Resources inside a VPC are isolated from other customers and from the public internet by default.

faq.question: Can VPCs connect to on-premises networks?
faq.answer: Yes, through VPN connections or dedicated links like AWS Direct Connect and Azure ExpressRoute. VPC peering also connects VPCs across accounts or regions. These connections extend your private network seamlessly into the cloud.
